AUTO_ENTREPRENEUR.name: Auto-entrepreneur
AUTO_ENTREPRENEUR.desc: Freelancers and service providers holding an ANAE card.
AUTO_ENTREPRENEUR.needs: ANAE card, ID, NIN, selfie, RIB or CCP

INDIVIDUAL_TRADER.name: Individual trader or artisan
INDIVIDUAL_TRADER.desc: Shop owners and individual e-merchants (personne physique).
INDIVIDUAL_TRADER.needs: RC or artisan card (RAM), NIF, ID, NIN, selfie, RIB or CCP

COMPANY.name: Company
COMPANY.desc: EURL, SARL, SNC and other legal entities.
COMPANY.needs: RC, NIF, NIS, statuts, manager ID, beneficial owners, company RIB

ENTERPRISE.name: Enterprise
ENTERPRISE.needs: Company documents, delegation of signing authority, financial statements, AML questionnaire

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Resume your signup or follow your application.

helper.title: Help me choose
helper.intro: Answer up to three quick questions.

q.rc: Do you have an RC (registre de commerce)?
q.ram: Do you have an artisan (RAM) card?
q.anae: Do you have an ANAE auto-entrepreneur card?

hint.rc: If your business is a company (EURL, SARL…), you can switch to Company on the next screen.
hint.ram: The artisan card is issued by the Chamber of Crafts.
hint.anae: The card is issued by ANAE (Agence nationale de l’auto-entrepreneur).

noStatus.title: A legal status is required
noStatus.intro: You can’t continue the Partner signup without one.
noStatus.reason: To accept payments for a business you must be registered as an auto-entrepreneur, an artisan, a trader or a company.
noStatus.appBody: As an individual you can send and receive money with the customer app.
noStatus.anaeBody: The ANAE card is the simplest way to start a registered activity.

settlement.mismatchPerson: The account holder name does not match your name on the ID. Check it, or your application may be rejected.
settlement.mismatchCompany: The account holder name does not match the company name. Company and Enterprise must use an account in the company’s name.
settlement.enterpriseNote: This volume qualifies you as an Enterprise partner. We will add an Enterprise documents step, and a signed contract is required before you go live.

submitted.title: Thank you, we received your application
submitted.intro: Our team reviews applications within about {{hours}} hours.
submitted.n1: We review your documents and details.
submitted.n2: You get an email with the decision. If something is missing, you will see exactly what to fix.
submitted.n3: When approved, your live API keys are activated and you can start accepting payments.
submitted.contract: Enterprise partners must also sign a contract before going live.

status.title: Application status
status.pending: Your application is being reviewed. This usually takes about {{hours}} hours.
status.contractPendingBody: Your account is approved. Go-live stays blocked until our team marks your contract as signed.
status.contractSigned: Your contract is signed. You can go live.
status.limitsNote: Limits depend on your partner type and declared volume.
status.liveBlocked: Your live key activates when the contract is signed.

notif.CONTRACT_SIGNED: Email: contract signed, you can go live
notif.AE_CAP_80: Email: you reached 80% of your annual cap
notif.AE_CAP_100: Email: annual cap reached, account under review
notif.VOLUME_ABOVE_BAND: Email: volume above your declared band

fix.title: Fix and resubmit
fix.intro: Only the items our team flagged are open. Everything else is kept as you entered it.
fix.nothingFlagged: No specific item was flagged. You can resubmit your application as it is.

post.cap80: You reached {{pct}}% of the annual auto-entrepreneur cap. Upgrade now to keep accepting payments without interruption.
post.cap100Flag: You reached the annual cap. Your account is flagged for review by our team.
post.cap100Block: You reached the annual cap. New transactions are blocked until you upgrade.
post.volumeTitle: Your volume is above your declared band
post.volumeBody: This month: {{current}}. Declared: {{band}}. Our team will review your account. Please update your declared volume.
post.volumeNote: Your limits stay the same until our team reviews your new volume.
post.upgradeBody: Your identity and settlement details are pre-filled. You only complete the new type-specific step.
post.upgradeKeepsLimits: Your current account keeps working at its current limits until the upgrade is approved.
post.restrictionBody: Payment links and invoices are only allowed in the categories mapped to your ANAE activity code ({{code}}).
post.categoryAllowed: This category is allowed for your activity.
post.categoryDenied: Your ANAE activity does not allow this category. Allowed: {{allowed}}.

detail.draftNote: Incomplete signup. Last completed step: {{step}}. Review actions are available after submission.
detail.noActions: No review action available for this status.

detail.previewMock: Mock preview (files are not stored in this build)

approve.title: Approve this submission?
approve.body: Merchant and KYB become APPROVED, the partner is placed in KYC Level {{level}}, the limits for the type and band are applied and the partner is notified.
approve.checklistWarn: Only {{done}} of {{total}} checklist items are ticked.
approve.contractNote: Enterprise: the live API key stays inactive until you mark the contract as signed.
approve.done: Submission approved. The partner was notified.

reject.title: Reject this submission
reject.body: The partner sees the reason in the portal and receives it by email.
reject.textHint: Explain what is wrong and how to fix it.
reject.flaggedHint: Only flagged items are reopened when the partner resubmits.
reject.done: Submission rejected. The partner was notified by email.

contract.title: Mark the contract as signed?
contract.body: This activates the live API keys and unblocks go-live. Contract e-signature is handled outside the platform.
contract.done: Contract marked as signed. Live keys are active.
